## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any platforms or behavior left unverified. Include before/after screenshots or a short recording for visual changes.

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve unrelated behavior.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; meaningful regressions have coverage.
- [ ] User-visible milestones are reflected in `docs/changelog.md`.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or private solutions are included.
